main_text.p: Theod. l.3. c.9.tulus) πνευματικοὶ ἀληθείας: Quoufq; sacra permiserit veritas, comitabimur profecto alacres; si quid vltrà, confistimus, recedimus; & quæ duo hæresèos remedia suasit olim Epiphanius τὸ φεύγειν, ἡ μὴ συναμιλλᾶσθαι, Epiph. l.1. initio.ea nos vtraque sedulo adhibemus. Inexpiabilis quidem & grauis culpa discordiæ (vt grauissimè Cyprianus) nec paßlione purgatur. Cypr. de simplic. prælat.Et nos Aten illam Homericam vno inferno dignam arbitramur: Neque tamen iustum est veritatis precium, concordia; quam redimere quidem nobis fas est, vendere piaculo: Age ergo, discutiamus singula, & quod fieri

page.notes: Greek words in the first and second lines are partly worn and are transcribed as best read; "paßlione" is printed as shown (likely passione). The word "arbitramur" is followed by a printed mark (a dash-like blot) which may be damage. Marginal notes are small and partly faded.
